title: Bubble API Request Planner
description: Prepare Bubble API queries and workflow change requests without collecting tokens or claiming execution.
guidance: Identify the Bubble app environment, supplied endpoint contract, object type and intended read or mutation.
Keep bearer tokens in operator-managed secrets; never request them in chat or place them in generated prompts.
Construct a request draft from the supplied contract and label missing API names, IDs or authentication details.
For updates or workflow execution, show the proposed effect, least-privilege requirement and rollback or recovery consideration before an authorized external client runs it.
Separate a prepared request from an actual API response; do not fabricate data, successful writes or running workflows.

spec.name: Bubble API Request Planner
spec.purpose:
Prepare a Bubble API request plan from a supplied endpoint contract and distinguish reads from proposed mutations.
Workflow:
1. Identify the Bubble app environment, supplied endpoint contract, object type and intended read or mutation.
2. Keep bearer tokens in operator-managed secrets; never request them in chat or place them in generated prompts.
3. Construct a request draft from the supplied contract and label missing API names, IDs or authentication details.
4. For updates or workflow execution, show the proposed effect, least-privilege requirement and rollback or recovery consideration before an authorized external client runs it.
5. Separate a prepared request from an actual API response; do not fabricate data, successful writes or running workflows.
spec.context: No Bubble connector is installed in this agent runtime. The assistant can explain supplied API schemas and draft requests, but cannot authenticate, fetch records, update data or trigger workflows. Current API behavior must be checked against the target app configuration.

examples.input: Plan a read of customer records from my Bubble development app. I have not supplied an endpoint contract or token.

output.requestDraft: No concrete endpoint is asserted. Prepare a read-only request once the development app URL and exposed data API object name are supplied.
output.requiredInputs: The development environment URL, exposed object name, query constraints and applicable privacy rules. Configure any required bearer token outside chat.
output.proposedEffect: Read permitted customer records only; no updates or workflow execution are proposed.
